bookingReceived.subject: Your places are held · {code}

paymentReceived.preview: We have received a payment for {code}.
paymentReceived.heading: Thank you for your payment
paymentReceived.introNoAmount: We have received a payment for booking {code}.

bookingConfirmed.next: Before departure, we will be in touch to complete the traveller details and send your detailed itinerary.

kind.balance: This is the balance of {amount} for your journey.

paymentLink.expiry: The link works once and expires at {time} (Vietnam time).
